method: Used publicly retrievable official AFL/club HTML and indexed public player-profile pages; no blocked api.afl.com.au endpoint or authentication endpoint was called
Queried Wikipedia public pageprops once for all 32 exact titles, checked ambiguous hits, and attempted public Wikidata name search; rate-limited results are unknown, not evidence of absence
Compared exact case-folded names to historical public Wikimedia AFL beta catalogue and existing commercial match fields; a name-only or disambiguation QID is never adopted
Collected factual evidence only; no canonical UUID, candidate definition, live mutation or activation created

No claim that missing Wikipedia pages or incomplete/rate-limited Wikidata search proves no Wikidata entity exists
